dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 王明，我的手机坏了，怎么办？
dialogue.reading: Wáng Míng, wǒ de shǒujī huài le, zěnme bàn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 刚才手机自己关机了，现在不能开机了。
dialogue.reading: Gāngcái shǒujī zìjǐ guānjī le, xiànzài bù néng kāijī le.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Shì bù shì méi diàn le?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Bù huì ba? Wǒ zǎoshang chōngdiàn le.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Nǐ yòng wǒ de chōngdiànqì shìshi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: …… kāijī le! Zhēnde shì méi diàn le.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 哈哈，你的手机没坏，不用修了！
dialogue.reading: Hāhā, nǐ de shǒujī méi huài, bùyòng xiū le!
